abstract: Human trophoblast in normal implantation and placentation appears to undergo two different pathways of differentiation resulting in the development of villous and extravillous trophoblast. Cytotrophoblast (CT) differentiates abruptly into syncytiotrophoblast (ST) on the villous surface as compared with the spectrum of differentiation exhibited by extravillous trophoblast where CT differentiates into intermediate trophoblast (IT) and then into multinucleated intermediate trophoblastic cells (MITC). The various types of gestational trophoblastic lesions can be defined and related to discrete pathologic aberrations occurring at different stages of trophoblastic differentiation. The rapid advance in the discovery of new trophoblastic markers has facilitated the molecular dissection of the lineage and differentiation stages of trophoblast and related these to various trophoblastic lesions. Furthermore, antibodies against these markers, especially those that are able to recognize formalin-resistant epitopes, have considerable value in the study and differential diagnosis of different types of gestational trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 正常な着床と胎盤形成において、栄養膜細胞は絨毛性と絨毛外性の2つの経路に分化すると考えられる。絨毛性では細胞性栄養膜細胞(CT)が絨毛表面で合胞体栄養膜細胞(ST)へと急速に分化する。一方、絨毛外栄養膜細胞ではCTが中間型栄養膜細胞(IT)、さらに多核性中間型栄養膜細胞(MITC)へと分化する。各種の妊娠性絨毛性病変は、栄養膜分化の異なる段階における特定の病態異常と関連づけて定義できる。新たな栄養膜マーカーの発見により、栄養膜の系譜と分化段階の分子レベルでの解析が進み、それらを各種の栄養膜病変と関連づけることが可能になった。とくに、ホルマリン固定後も抗原性を保つエピトープを認識する抗体は、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の各種病型の研究および鑑別診断において大きな価値を持つ。
